message: WTI 75 PEACE-SLIDE TRIGGER: crude breaking below post-June-MoU shelf = June-template slide may be real. PLAYBOOK: 1) check radar - are Energy/Oil E&P still IGNITING? if dropped off, condition met. 2) FIRST bank the SLB paper call per its exits. 3) then paper puts per overlay rules ($2.5k, 45-90 DTE, delta .60-.75) ONLY on crude-linked names clear of earnings (SLB complex, CVX, XOM) - NEVER refiners (PBF/DK/VLO rallied +10% through the June crude collapse). 4) KILL RULE: any re-escalation headline = exit immediately - every peace window died within 27 days (Apr=4d, Apr2=13d, Jun=27d). Talks-stage peace = 2 of 3 head fakes; only the SIGNED June MoU paid.
